outcomes_added.question_summary: Find the three-digit positive integer \(\underline{a}\,\underline{b}\,\underline{c}\) whose representation in base nine is \(\underline{b}\,\underline{c}\,\underline{a}_{\,\text{nine}}\)
outcomes_added.observation: The model correctly set up the equality between the decimal number and the decimal value of the base-9 representation, derived a linear Diophantine equation, and systematically tested feasible digit values until it found a valid solution. The reasoning was detailed and included verification of digit constraints.
